tabs.title: Raw Data Validation

tabs.content:
// Show the latest availability snapshot by neighbourhood
BikeShareRaw
| summarize arg_max(ingestion_time(), *) by BikepointID
| summarize
    TotalBikes = sum(No_Bikes),
    TotalEmptyDocks = sum(No_Empty_Docks),
    BikePoints = dcount(BikepointID)
    by Neighbourhood
| extend TotalDocks = TotalBikes + TotalEmptyDocks
| extend AvailabilityPercent = round(100.0 * TotalBikes / TotalDocks, 1)
| order by TotalBikes desc
tabs.title: Live Operations

tabs.content:
// Validate the minute-level neighbourhood aggregation
BikeAvailabilityMinute
| summarize
    TotalRows = count(),
    Neighbourhoods = dcount(Neighbourhood),
    TimeWindows = dcount(Window_End_Time),
    NullNeighbourhood = countif(isempty(Neighbourhood)),
    InvalidBikeCount = countif(TotalBikes < 0)
tabs.title: Minute Aggregation Validation

tabs.content:
// Show the total bike availability trend across all neighbourhoods
BikeAvailabilityMinute
| summarize TotalAvailableBikes = sum(TotalBikes) by Window_End_Time
| order by Window_End_Time asc
| render timechart
tabs.title: Minute Availability Trend
